title: Linear Review (2026)
intro: Linear is evaluated here as an engineering / Agile issue tracker — Linear is a fast, opinionated issue tracker for software product teams (cycles, projects, roadmaps). Free covers limited issues/members; Basic/Standard ~$8–$10/user/mo annual; Business/Plus ~$14–$16; Enterprise custom. Landscape peer to Jira for modern eng UX — not a general Work OS. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s project-management methodology (ease of use, work planning, automation, collaboration, integrations, reporting, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Linear when product/engineering teams want a fast modern issue tracker — landscape beside Jira, not ranked as a monday/Asana Work OS peer.
verdict: Choose Linear when product/engineering teams want a fast modern issue tracker — landscape beside Jira, not ranked as a monday/Asana Work OS peer. Compare Jira for enterprise Agile depth, ClickUp for cross-functional Work OS, and Height only if niche demand appears. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Best-in-class modern eng UX — dramatically easier than classic Jira for product engineers.
Cycles, projects, issues and roadmaps fit software planning tightly.
Automations exist but are leaner than Jira’s enterprise rule engines.
Great for eng/product; weaker as a company-wide Work OS collaborator.
GitHub/GitLab/Slack-class eng stack integrations are strong.
Insights suitable for product teams; not PMO portfolio BI.
Scales well for product orgs; enterprise controls on higher tiers.
Competitive eng-tracker floors vs Jira. Affiliate economics excluded.
AI assists exist; not the primary product wedge vs Motion.

cons: Landscape-only on general PM best lists
limitations: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS

faq.question: Is Linear a project management / work OS tool?
faq.answer: No. Linear is an adjacent desktop workspace organizer. It wraps web apps into desktop shells — it is not a project tracker or work OS.

faq.question: How is Linear priced?
faq.answer: Free limited; Basic ~$8, Business ~$14 per user/mo annual (medium). Confirm live.

faq.question: Does Linear have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: Yes — a free plan is published. A free trial is documented. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Linear?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
